summary.en: Israel has intensified airstrikes and artillery against Hezbollah sites in Lebanon, including a deep strike on a Hezbollah stronghold, while Hezbollah is shifting to guerrilla tactics and drone warfare ahead of a possible Israeli incursion. Lebanese authorities have charged five Hezbollah members with recruiting and arming others and imposed sanctions on a charity and gold companies linked to the group. Iraq reached a compromise with a powerful pro-Iran militia to prevent a clash, according to officials. The conflict caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israel har økt luftangrep og artilleri mot Hizbollah-mål i Libanon, inkludert et dypgående angrep på en Hizbollah-festning, mens Hizbollah går over til geriljataktikk og dronedrift i forkant av en mulig israelsk inntrengning. Libanesiske myndigheter har siktet fem Hizbollah-medlemmer for rekruttering og våpenforsyning, og har innført sanksjoner mot en veldedighetsorganisasjon og gullbedrifter knyttet til gruppen. Irak har oppnådd en avtale med en mektig pro-iransk milits for å hindre en konfrontasjon, ifølge tjenestemenn. Konflikten førte til 4 335 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
